reference_commit: cesm3.0-alphabranch cmeps checkout + fork branch instrument/cmeps-dumps (EqESM-cesm-cmeps bb957c8, cmeps submodule d81b5cc1; earlier pointer 735eb8b with submodule bd88a843)
description: CMEPS atmosphere-ocean bulk-flux boundary traces from an instrumented C_JRA_t62 (DATM+MOM6) CESM run (PLAN.md CMEPS lane): the full flux_atmOcn_large chain of cesm/flux_atmocn/flux_atmocn_Large.F90 (Large & Pond / Large & Yeager scheme as configured in nuopc.runconfig: add_gusts=.false., coldair_outbreak_mod=.false., aofluxes_use_shr_wv_sat=.true., minwind=0.5 m/s, flux_convergence=0.01, flux_max_iteration=5), one row per traced ocean point per coupling step. Columns: the 12 raw inputs (zbot, ubot, vbot, thbot, qbot, rainc, rbot, tbot, pslv, us, vs, ts), the derived inputs (vmag, wind0, ugust, esat, qsat, ssq, delt, delq, alz, cp), the neutral first estimates (stable0, rdn0, rhn0, ren0), the exit state of the stability iteration (iter, hol, stable, xsq, xqq, psimh, psixh, rd, u10n, rdn, rhn, ren, rh, re, ustar, tstar, qstar), the fluxes (tau, taux, tauy, sen, lat, lwup, evap) and the 2-m/10-m diagnostics (hol2, xsq2, xqq2, psix2, fac_t, fac_q, tref, qref, duu10n, u10res), plus the point metadata (n local ogrid index on PET 0, gid global element index, lat/lon).

regenerate.note: Fork worktree stage1/EqESM-cesm-cmeps (branch instrument/cmeps-dumps, cmeps submodule on instrument/cmeps-dumps), CIME scripts from the pristine checkout stage1/cesm/cime. The dump is gated by the mediator attribute dump_cmeps (default .false., set in user_nl_cpl), writes PET 0 only, and traces for the first dump_first_steps coupling steps; CSV lands in stage1/dumps/cmeps/ (dump_dir in user_nl_cpl) under the name dump_file (default cmeps_aoflux.csv). Traced cells: either the first dump_first_cells masked ocean cells (fixed mode) or, when dump_stable_cells + dump_wind_cells > 0 (dynamic mode), the per-step union of the dump_stable_cells most-stable cells (delt = thbot - ts > 0) and the dump_wind_cells strongest-wind cells (relative wind sqrt((ubot-us)^2+(vbot-vs)^2)) of ALL masked PET-0 cells, deduped and sorted by local index (med_dump_mod.F90 med_dump_select; reads the raw aoflux inputs only, so it is solution-neutral). user_nl_mom carries AUTO_MASKTABLE=False to match the reference case (root cause of a MOM6 init FATAL; buildnml regenerates MOM_override during case.build). Floats are written es26.17e3 with subnormals flushed to 0.0 (gfortran es26.17 omits the exponent letter, bugs.md #29); rainc is dumped as 0 on the no-gusts path (the mediator's 1-element dummy allocation is uninitialized, bugs.md #28). Run takes ~8 min wall; ~140 s rebuild per dump-module change. case.submit must be run with SLURM_MEM_PER_NODE/CPU/GPU unset when the submitting shell carries them (srun: mutually exclusive error).

dump_files.cmeps_aoflux.csv: # description + # columns header, then one row per (step, traced cell): step,ymd,tod,n,gid,iter,lat,lon,zbot,ubot,vbot,thbot,qbot,rainc,rbot,tbot,pslv,us,vs,ts,vmag,wind0,ugust,esat,qsat,ssq,delt,delq,alz,cp,stable0,rdn0,rhn0,ren0,hol,stable,xsq,xqq,psimh,psixh,rd,u10n,rdn,rhn,ren,rh,re,ustar,tstar,qstar,tau,taux,tauy,sen,lat,lwup,evap,hol2,xsq2,xqq2,psix2,fac_t,fac_q,tref,qref,duu10n,u10res - inputs and outputs of flux_atmOcn_large (see the # description header for per-column units and F90 line citations); hol/xsq/xqq are the zbot-level pre-2m-rescale values (hol0/xsq0/xqq0 of the instrumentation), hol2/xsq2/xqq2 the 2-m-rescaled diagnostics. Note: 'lat' names both the cell latitude (first occurrence) and the latent-heat flux (second); validators resolve the collision by name
dump_files.cmeps_aoflux_wide.csv: same columns and header conventions as cmeps_aoflux.csv, but the traced cells are selected per coupling step (dynamic mode, dump_stable_cells=8/dump_wind_cells=8): the 8 strongest-wind cells of ALL masked PET-0 cells by relative wind sqrt((ubot-us)^2+(vbot-vs)^2) plus the 8 most-stable cells (delt = thbot - ts > 0), union, deduped, sorted by local index. 192 rows = 8 wind-selected rows x 24 steps (the stable selection found no delt > 0 cell on PET 0 in this window); 9 distinct cells (n 6933, 6934, 7024, 7025, 7026, 7112, 7115, 7116, 7117; gid 41583, 41584, 42124, 42125, 42126, 42662, 42665, 42666, 42667), all ~69 S, a subset of the fixed window's 12 cells (the weakest-wind cells n 7023/7113/7114 never make the top-8)

traced_domain.cells: fixed dump: first 12 masked ocean cells of PET 0 (dump_first_cells=12): local ogrid indices n 6933..7117, global element ids gid 41583..42667, all ~69 S on the Antarctic coast (PET 0's slice of the tx0.66v1 ocean grid), lon 74.0..77.3 E (ESMF [-360, 0] convention). Wide dump (dynamic mode): per-step union of the 8 strongest-wind cells (relative wind) and the 8 most-stable cells (delt > 0) of ALL masked PET-0 cells, deduped, sorted by n; the stable selection is empty in this window, so 8 wind cells/step from a pool of 9 distinct cells (a subset of the fixed window's 12)
traced_domain.steps: all 24 hourly coupling steps of the 1-month run (dump_first_steps=24)
traced_domain.rows: 288 (12 cells x 24 steps, fixed) + 192 (8 rows/step x 24 steps, wide; per-step cell sets vary)

checks.bit_identical_outputs: instrumented run restarts md5-identical to the reference C_JRA_t62 run for BOTH dumps (cpl.r 0f47e2f0f4f207240148d8ef333d5044, datm.r e14609a64cbba942d56a9eaa961c4bda, dice.r 8e1656e609b0c189b68284b940b2a19b, drof.r 002ca0b2a42c135246a5134e2517e00e, mom6.r 2f19de039ced94bcd30930385cc29b76) and ocean.stats.nc byte-identical, so the dump code (fixed and dynamic selection) changes nothing when enabled
checks.full_replay: stage1/analysis/validate_cmeps_dump.py replays flux_atmOcn_large from the dumped inputs and reproduces all 46 compared columns (every dumped column except the 12 inputs and the metadata) on all rows to <= 4.4e-15 relative (288 fixed-window rows; wide dump 192 rows to <= 3.4e-15, worst columns fac_t/fac_q), and the dumped iter on every row (fixed window: 2 x145, 3 x85, 4 x37, 5 x21; wide window: 2 x126, 3 x57, 4 x9)
checks.structure: both dumps: 2 header lines (# description, # columns), 67 columns, zero wrong-arity rows, zero NaN, zero spval-like values (rainc = 0 on all rows after the bugs.md #28 fix); wide dump additionally passes the per-step row-count check (8 rows/step, cell set varying per step as expected of the dynamic selection)
checks.coverage: fixed dump: all 288 rows unstable (hol in [-10.0, -1.16], 21 rows pinned at the |hol| <= 10 clamp) with low-to-moderate wind (vmag 0.5..4.8 m/s, 17 rows pinned at the minwind = 0.5 m/s floor) and small nonzero ocean currents (us/vs in +/-0.13 m/s). Wide dump: the exhaustive per-step ranking of all masked PET-0 cells picks the strongest-wind rows the run offers (vmag 0.63..4.81 m/s, iteration counts 2/3/4) - the stable branch (delt > 0 nowhere on PET 0 in this January window), the cdn 33 m/s wind cap (domain wind max 4.81 m/s), the add_gusts gustiness path and the cold-air-outbreak path are NOT exercised by either window
checks.iteration_representation: the esm model unrolls the 5 fixed-point updates and selects the exit state by conv_k = |(ustar_k - ustar_{k-1})/ustar_k| <= 0.01 (k = 1..4), iter = first converged k else 5; the stage-2 tests pin conv_1..4 and iter alongside the dumped columns
